item_short_desc: Get up and go with our Camo Canvas Tote Bag, offering plenty of space for carrying everyday essentials, clothing, beach supplies, and more. Whether you are heading to work, gym, the beach, or on a weekend getaway, the large tote bag ensures you have additional storage space anywhere you go. The canvas bag features 2 exterior storage pockets for securing small items. The beach bag measures approximately 18 inch x 15 inch x 5 inch overall and has a 23L storage capacity.
description: Get up and go with our Camo Canvas Tote Bag, offering plenty of space for carrying everyday essentials, clothing, beach supplies, and more. From outdoor adventures to beach days, these multipurpose tote bags are great to have on hand, especially for extra storge and carrying capacity. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs. All Things Camo: Rothco stands out as the leader in camouflage clothing and accessories. With a rich heritage spanning over 7 decades, we have honed our expertise in crafting durable and effective camouflage gear. Our extensive range of products, including apparel, bags, and gear, showcases a diverse selection of camouflage, with over 35 patterns available! From outdoor enthusiasts and military personnel, to skate and fashion, Rothco is the go-to brand for camo.
